h1: Castaway Resort Koh Lipe — two-storey wooden bungalows on Sunrise Beach that people love despite no AC
intro: Picture this: a two-storey wooden bungalow with a thatched roof, two hammocks swinging on the deck, a few steps to the white sand of Sunrise Beach, no AC, no TV — just the sound of waves and the sea breeze. This is Castaway Resort Koh Lipe, an eco-leaning boutique resort that has sat near the top of the island's rankings for years · 43 rustic wooden bungalows tucked among the trees, designed to catch the natural breeze · from approx. ฿4,500/night for a garden-view bungalow in normal season.
galleryAlts: Two-storey thatched wooden bungalow at Castaway Resort tucked under trees right on Sunrise Beach
Wooden deck with a hammock in front of a bungalow looking out over the turquoise Andaman Sea
White-sand Sunrise Beach in front of the resort with clear water and longtail boats moored nearby

body.html: Castaway is the name that keeps coming up for travellers who want "on the beach but not a concrete block" on Koh Lipe · what people remember is the two-storey wooden bungalows with thatched roofs and a rustic, natural design meant to blend into the trees rather than feel like a polished air-conditioned room · 43 of them run from a shady garden zone in the jungle out to the front row right on Sunrise Beach · it has been around long enough to become one of the island's signature stays, and still ranks #5 of 28 hotels on Tripadvisor with a 4.2 score from over 1,000 reviews.

Bungalows split into three main zones · the most wallet-friendly is the Garden View Breezy / Comfy (32–36 sqm), set among the trees and ideal if you're out exploring all day and just come back to sleep · a step up is the Sea View Breezy (32 sqm), second row with sea glimpses through the foliage · the one most people want is the Beach Front Breezy (32 sqm) and Big Beach Front (42 sqm), front row right on the sand with the sea at your door · every unit is an open-plan two-storey wooden house with a deck, hammock and queen bed — but they all use ceiling fans and mosquito nets, with no AC, no hot water, no TV and no fridge, which is the key thing to know before booking.

"Woke up, opened the door to the sunrise sea right in front of me, sat in the hammock with a coffee listening to birds, trees all around — it gets hot midday for sure, but no air-con can give you this."

What guests praise again and again is the staff and the atmosphere · reviews across platforms rate the team especially high (Booking gives staff a 9.5) — kind, helpful, they remember you · the resort itself is quiet, green and full of birdsong, with many guests reaching for words like "peace and serenity" · the beachside restaurant earns praise for the food and a strong line-up of vegetarian/vegan options, which is rare on the island · there's a Happy Hour from 4–6pm overlooking the sea, daily yoga, and free refill water stations in keeping with the resort's eco leaning.

Water activities are sorted in-house · there's an on-site Castaway Divers dive centre running courses and trips for scuba and snorkelling around the Adang-Rawi islands straight from the beach · plus free kayaks, paddleboards and snorkel masks to borrow, a beachside Thai massage spa, and island-hopping trips arranged for you · ideal if you're on Koh Lipe mainly to get in the water and don't want to walk off to find a dive shop elsewhere.

It sits on the quieter end of Sunrise Beach · it's a fair walk from the central walking street — around 12–15 minutes on foot, or a quick island tuk-tuk — a plus if you want to escape the bustle, but it can feel far if you like popping in and out of evening restaurants · the recurring note in reviews is the heat and humidity in the rooms because there's no AC, especially once the mosquito net is down and it blocks airflow from the fan; some guests meet mosquitoes too · and at peak times longtail boats moor along the beachfront, which can block the view and swimming space.

Honestly, Castaway isn't for everyone · if you can't sleep without AC and you want hot water, a TV, a fridge and a sleek modern room — this place doesn't offer that, and never set out to · but if you come to Koh Lipe to live slowly on the beach, sleep to the waves, swing in a hammock, dive, and you don't mind doing without hotel comforts — Castaway is the kind of old-school island bungalow vibe that gets harder to find on Lipe each year, and the people who love it tend to come back.

A tip from reading real reviews: if you're coming in the hot season or worry about heat, choose a front-row beachfront bungalow — it catches the sea breeze far better than the more sheltered garden zone · bring your own mosquito repellent · and check that breakfast isn't included in the rate — you order it separately at the beachside restaurant.

honestSummary: Castaway Resort is a wooden-bungalow stay right on Sunrise Beach that delivers an old-school island vibe — quiet, green, on the water, with diving sorted in-house · ideal for travellers who want to live slowly with nature and don't need hotel-style comforts · but you must accept rooms with no AC, no hot water, and heat and humidity at times, plus a longer walk to the walking street than mid-island stays.
honestChecks: If you can't sleep without AC — every bungalow uses ceiling fans and mosquito nets, with no AC and no hot water, so it gets hot and humid in the warm season → if that's a dealbreaker, choose a resort with air-conditioned rooms, or at least pick a front-row beachfront bungalow that catches the sea breeze.

If you want to pop in and out of nightlife — the resort sits at the quiet end of Sunrise Beach, a 12–15 minute walk to the walking street → if you want to be near restaurants and bars, a mid-island or Pattaya Beach stay is more convenient.
If you're planning the low season (May–Oct) — Koh Lipe gets strong monsoon weather, many places close and ferries reduce sailings → check the resort is open and the sea conditions before booking.

tips.title: Worried about heat? Pick a front-row bungalow
tips.body: No rooms have AC — all use fan + net. Front-row beachfront units catch the sea breeze far better than the sheltered garden zone, which matters most in the hot season.

tips.title: Bring your own mosquito repellent
tips.body: The resort sits among trees, so there are some mosquitoes. Nets are provided in every room, but pack spray or repellent too, especially for the evenings.

tips.title: Book a dive trip with Castaway Divers
tips.body: There's a dive centre on site running Adang-Rawi trips straight from the beach, with free kayaks and paddleboards — no need to walk off to another shop.

tips.title: Breakfast not included — order at the beach restaurant
tips.body: Rates don't include breakfast; order at the beachside restaurant, which has plenty of vegetarian/vegan options. Happy Hour runs 4–6pm.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Castaway Resort Koh Lipe

faq.q: Which beach is Castaway Resort on, and how do you get there?
faq.a: It's right on Sunrise Beach, Koh Lipe, Satun province, at the quieter end of the beach · it's about a 12–15 minute walk to the central walking street, or a quick island tuk-tuk · to reach Koh Lipe you take a ferry from Pak Bara Pier (Satun) then a longtail boat onto the beach; the resort can help arrange transfers, so ask ahead.

No — none of the rooms have AC · every bungalow uses a ceiling fan and mosquito net, with no hot water, TV or fridge, as it's an eco-leaning resort designed to catch the natural breeze · if you worry about heat, choose a front-row beachfront bungalow that gets the sea breeze better than the garden zone, and bring extra mosquito repellent.

faq.q: How much does Castaway Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: From approx. ฿4,500/night for a Garden View Breezy (32 sqm, garden view) · Sea View Breezy around ฿6,000 · Beach Front Breezy on the sand around ฿8,500 · Big Beach Front sleeping 3 around ฿10,500 · prices swing with the season and rise fast at peak — compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Castaway Resort best for?
faq.a: Best for couples and travellers who love an old-school island bungalow vibe, being close to nature, and diving · it's quiet, with an on-site dive centre, yoga and a beachside spa · if you want a modern air-conditioned room with full comforts, or to be near nightlife, a mid-island resort would suit you better.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Castaway Resort?
faq.a: The best window is November to April, when the sea is calm and the water is clear · the rainy season (May–Oct) brings strong monsoon weather, many island places close and ferries reduce sailings, so check the resort is open and the sea conditions before planning.

faq.q: Does Castaway Resort include breakfast, and how is the food?
faq.a: Rates don't include breakfast — you order it at the beachside restaurant · the restaurant is praised for its food and has plenty of vegetarian/vegan options, which is rare on the island · there's a Happy Hour from 4–6pm overlooking the sea · for variety or to save money, the walking street has lots of restaurants too.
